principle: Environment facts, learned immediate providers, and value readouts remain different objects even when the actor maximizes their common discounted return.

unchanged_transition_interface.rule: Exact final reached state is used whenever available; one counted pre-step fallback is permitted only when the environment cannot expose final observation.

common_update_protocol: Collect immutable behavior transitions and raw environment evidence.
Freeze target actor, target F/B, normalizers, and every reward-provider snapshot used by a target.
Update representation/provider parameters only from their declared data laws.
Materialize each provider channel once with detached parameters, its version, sign, and temporal anchor.
Train vector successor or named helper critics on the immutable materialized channels.
Freeze F/B/providers/critics and materialize actor values or advantages once.
Update the actor without a gradient path through a state-only provider or value target.
Discard an on-policy rollout, or retain an off-policy edge only with its immutable behavior and provenance fields.

stages.purpose: Reproduce the validated native algorithms before removing expert data.
stages.positive_law: Expert current states paired with contexts derived from aligned expert windows.
stages.negative_law: Current replay states paired with their immutable behavior contexts.

provider.name: discriminator
provider.freeze: snapshot for reward and Bellman target materialization

stages.value_path: named discriminator helper critic or declared vector-successor channel
stages.actor_path: maximize detached helper value with the frozen coefficient
stages.gate: Native MetaMotivo and BFM non-inferiority remains unchanged.

stages.purpose: Remove expert trajectories while retaining a non-degenerate context-conditioned intrinsic objective.
stages.positive_law: Pair a behavior context z_t with a future reached state from the same episode and unchanged context segment; sample the future offset from a declared distribution.
stages.negative_law: Pair that same z_t with a reached state sampled independently from another valid context segment; reject accidental same-segment pairs.

provider.name: own_experience_discriminator
provider.freeze: snapshot for one complete representation/value/actor block

anti_shortcut_checks: Positive and negative state marginals use the same replay snapshot.
Context identifiers, padding, episode length, clip identity, and reset source cannot reveal the label.
Held-out logits are reported by future-offset and context-frequency bins.
A shuffled-context control must collapse to chance.
stages.value_path: the same named helper critic or vector-successor channel as reproduction
stages.actor_path: maximize detached helper value; no actor gradient enters the discriminator
stages.gate: Beat the shuffled-context control and retain native safety before expert data is removed from later stages.

stages.purpose: Replace style classification with a task-independent efficiency objective when that is the intended task.

provider.name: physical_energy
provider.update: none for a fixed physical formula; a learned energy is a separate experiment with an external calibration target
provider.freeze: fixed channel definition and coefficients for the complete run

stages.source: Raw environment-owned torque, action-rate, contact, slip, and limit evidence with declared units and discretization.
stages.anti_collapse_rule: An unconstrained learned scalar E trained only by minimizing E on its own rollouts is invalid because the constant-minus-infinity solution is unconstrained.
stages.value_path: vector successor over raw energy components, then a fixed linear readout
stages.actor_path: maximize detached negative discounted energy subject to separately reported task and safety gates
stages.gate: Energy and task quality are both reported; an efficient policy that ceases to imitate is not a pass.

stages.purpose: Allow partial-observation value prediction without asserting that immediate reward is a function of phi.
stages.reward_identity: r_t is supplied by declared environment/provider channels; it is not defined by the value network.
stages.value_identity: V_alpha(H_t) = alpha^T Psi_R(H_t) for linear channel composition, or a deliberately detached nonlinear h(Psi_R(H_t)) trained from declared returns.
stages.residual_identity: r_t = V(H_t) - gamma * V(H_reached_t_plus_1) is a Bellman residual/reconstruction under the learned value and correct masks, not self-supervision for an otherwise reward-free value.

provider.name: none
provider.update: value readout is trained against returns from declared channels
provider.freeze: value or advantage is detached and materialized once before actor updates

stages.actor_path: maximize detached V or advantage; no actor gradient enters state-only value targets
stages.gate: Held-out return calibration and policy improvement both pass; recursive self-targeting without an anchored channel is rejected.

reported: provider reward distribution by context and episode phase
forbidden_shortcuts: Changing provider data law and actor coefficient in one comparison.
Recomputing a mutable provider inside an allegedly immutable actor update.
Training a learned energy without a non-collapse anchor.
Dropping final reached observations or context-segment masks.
